name: Giovanetti’s Italian Cuisine
notes: 3 photos, all menu boards/pages. Photo 1 is the full printed "La Pasta" menu page (15 dishes). Photos 2 and 3 are two different specials chalkboards photographed on different occasions (older board: $18 burrata salad, $25 ribs, $30 mahi-mahi, $30 pappardelle shrimp, $36 half rack of lamb; newer board: $18 bruschetta, $26 ribs, $38 sea bass, $26 eggplant lasagna, $42 half rack of lamb). The recurring baby back ribs special appeared on both boards with the same description at two prices ($25 then $26); kept once at $26. The two half-rack-of-lamb specials have different preparations/descriptions so both are kept.
